news.headline: Wedbush Cuts Nektar Price Target to $50 From $80, Keeps Neutral
news.summary: Wedbush cut its price target on Nektar to $50 from $80 while maintaining a Neutral rating, after shares tumbled as much as 9-11% when the deliberating federal jury sent a note to the judge asking about scenarios involving low or no damages in the Eli Lilly breach-of-contract trial. The move reflects rising market concern that Nektar may not win the roughly $1 billion in damages it is seeking.

news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments of the roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's counsel told a California federal jury that Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching the companies' co-development deal and delaying the drug in favor of a competing Lilly asset it later acquired. The jury began deliberating afterward and, as of September 24, 2026, has still not returned a verdict.

news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar $1B If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Jury Told
news.summary: Nektar's damages expert testified that Eli Lilly could owe the company nearly $1 billion if the jury finds it breached the 2017 license agreement to co-develop rezpegaldesleukin, laying out Nektar's financial theory of harm from Lilly's handling of the drug's early atopic dermatitis and lupus trials.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar disclosed it entered a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 that will continue until it publicly announces data from the 24-week off-treatment follow-up period of its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study. As of September 24, 2026 the company remains in this quiet period and the durability data have not yet been released.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results
news.summary: Nektar announced peer-reviewed publication in The Lancet of full efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamic and biomarker findings from the 16-week induction period of the 393-patient Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study, which met all primary and key secondary endpoints in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The publication bolsters the scientific case underpinning the newly launched Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a narrowed net loss of $40.6 million, with cash and investments of $1.02 billion as of June 30, 2026, bolstered by a $350 million public offering. The company highlighted the July 2026 start of its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis and finalized design of a registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study.

catalysts.label: Jury verdict in Nektar v. Eli Lilly trial
catalysts.detail: A California federal jury is deliberating on Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract claim alleging Lilly mishandled rezpegaldesleukin's co-development under their 2017 deal; as of September 24, 2026 no verdict has been returned, and a jury note asking about low-or-no-damages scenarios has raised market concern about the outcome. A verdict for Nektar could materially bolster its cash position, while a defense verdict or low-damages award would remove the litigation upside.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Nektar has been in a self-imposed quiet period since September 8, 2026 ahead of releasing 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, a key durability readout for rezpegaldesleukin; the data had not yet been announced as of September 24, 2026.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, with design finalized following FDA End-of-Phase 2 feedback and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: Initiation of ZENITH AD-3 (treatment-experienced) Phase 3 trial
catalysts.detail: The third and final trial of the global registrational ZENITH AD program, enrolling roughly 510 atopic dermatitis patients with prior biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is guided to begin in September 2026, completing initiation of the ~1,530-patient three-trial program alongside ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2 (both started July 2026).

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline results are expected from the global registrational ZENITH AD-1/AD-2/AD-3 program (about 1,530 patients) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with a BLA submission targeted for 2029.

catalysts.label: Third-quarter 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Nektar's next scheduled quarterly earnings report, which should provide updated commentary on cash runway (guided into Q3 2028), the outcome of the Lilly litigation, and REZOLVE-AA durability data if not yet released.

pulse: Nektar remains gripped by litigation suspense: the California federal jury weighing Nektar's roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract claim against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin has been deliberating since September 18 with no verdict as of September 24, and shares tumbled as much as 9-11% this week after the jury sent a note asking about low-or-no-damages scenarios, prompting Wedbush to cut its price target to $50 from $80 while keeping a Neutral rating. Separately, Nektar has been in a quiet period since September 8 ahead of Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata durability data, while the atopic dermatitis franchise keeps advancing on schedule following an August 25 Lancet publication of Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD data and the guided September start of the third Phase 3 ZENITH AD trial. Q2 2026 results showed cash and investments above $1 billion (runway into Q3 2028), but the stock has pulled back sharply from its highs into the high-$50s as investors price in binary risk from both the pending verdict and the alopecia durability readout.
